Company Introduction

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.

Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Overseas” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”

Role Overview

Coupang Taiwan is looking for an extraordinary talent to join our marketing team to manage high-impact customer activation programs to deliver customer growth for the business. In this role, you will lead end-to-end strategies across the entire customer lifecycle—from aggressive new user acquisition to driving engagement and retention for our paid subscription members (e.g., WOW). This is a high-visibility role where your experiments will directly influence our growth trajectory in one of the world's most dynamic e-commerce markets.

What You Will Do

• Scale New Customer Acquisition: Design and execute data-driven campaigns to accelerate top-of-funnel growth, driving high-intent user sign-ups and first-time purchases.
• Boost Subscription Member Engagement & Retention: Develop tailored engagement and lifecycle strategies to increase active usage, order frequency, and long-term retention for paid subscription members.
• Design & Implement Lifecycle Programs: Lead end-to-end activation programs to deliver specific goals like Customer Growth, Category Penetration, and Customer Reactivation.
• Cross-Functional Execution: Work seamlessly with cross-functional partners (CRM channels, Operations, Performance Marketing, Product, and Analytics) to execute cohesive, multi-channel campaigns.

• Customer Insights to Strategy: Collaborate with the Insights team to translate complex consumer behaviors into actionable marketing strategies.
• ROI & Governance: Partner with Finance to establish robust governance and ROI guardrails, ensuring marketing spend drives sustainable LTV and growth.

Basic Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in Customer Acquisition, Paid Membership/Subscription Management, CRM, Loyalty Programs, or Marketing Program Management in an e-commerce or digital business environment.
• Strong analytical skills and a proven track record of data-based decision making throughout the entire user lifecycle (Acquisition > Activation > Retention).

• Strong ability to prioritize across multiple complex tasks and workstreams.

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of Marketing or Program Management experience directly related to New User Acquisition or Subscription/Membership Growth Programs.

https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy-policy/​

Coupang Taiwan 正在尋找優秀的人才加入行銷團隊，負責規劃並執行高影響力的客戶活化（Customer Activation）計畫，推動業務成長。

這是一個高度曝光且具影響力的職位，你所推動的各項實驗與成長計畫，將直接影響 Coupang 在全球最具活力的電子商務市場之一的成長軌跡。

必備資格

• Acquisition
• Activation
• Retention

• 能夠在快速變動的環境中獨立工作，從 0 到 1 建立新專案與機制。
• 具備優秀的多工處理與優先順序管理能力。
• 具備優秀的中英文溝通能力。

加分條件

• 具備 5 年以上以下相關經驗：

• 新客成長（New User Acquisition）
• 會員／訂閱成長計畫（Membership & Subscription Growth Programs）
• 行銷或專案管理

• 具有電子商務或 B2C 產業實務經驗者佳。

• 驗證實驗結果

TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.

You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

Who you are

- A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.

- Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.

- Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.

- Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.

- Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.

- Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.

What we’re looking for

- 10+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.

- Experience at a high tech company.

- Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to paid to expansion journey.

- A track record of writing customer facing content, campaigns, or messaging that you can speak to in detail, and that you can point to measurable outcomes for.

- Experience partnering with product, growth, or lifecycle teams to bring messaging into their workflows, without owning the underlying roadmap or systems.

Preferred:

- Experience working alongside lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io http://Customer.io, even if you weren't the one operating them.

- Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM.

- Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences.

- Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams.

What you’ll do

- Own messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey, from signup through activation and expansion.

- Partner with the Growth PM to translate their roadmap and experimentation priorities into strong, on-brand messaging, bringing your own point of view on framing and positioning rather than just executing briefs.

- Work hand in hand with the Lifecycle team on new content and messaging for email, in-app surfaces, and push notifications, ensuring everything reflects our positioning and voice.

- Develop clear point of view documents and messaging guidance for different self serve segments (solo founders, indie hackers, small teams) that inform both lifecycle content and broader growth campaigns.

- Write and refine copy for high leverage touchpoints: onboarding flows, activation nudges, upgrade prompts, and in-app messaging.

- Review and sharpen messaging coming out of experiments and campaigns, helping the team understand not just whether something worked, but why, from a messaging and positioning lens.

- Build a shared messaging toolkit (voice, tone, positioning by segment, proof points) that Lifecycle and Growth can both draw from.

- Represent the messaging and positioning perspective in growth planning, as a thought partner to the Growth PM rather than an owner of the roadmap itself.

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

About this role

About FMA

BlackRock's Financial Markets Advisory group (“FMA”) provides counsel to financial institutions, sovereigns and official institutions across a range of strategic, capital, balance sheet, risk and regulatory matters, across both public and private markets. At the heart of “BlackRock as a platform” FMA aims to build or deepen BlackRock’s relationships with our clients’ senior management, serving them on their most critical and most complex needs.

The group brings together deep capital markets expertise, complex engagement management, data & analytics skills and strategic client advisory capabilities. At ~150 team members globally, FMA maintains a “boutique” focus, working where BlackRock brings unique perspective and experience and where we can advance BlackRock’s major commercial priorities.

We distinguish ourselves through the combination of deep practitioner expertise and extensive market presence, with a fully fiduciary mindset – including the ability to operate behind strict information barriers where circumstances require. FMA also acts as a key talent laboratory for the firm, with many of BlackRock’s senior leaders having built their careers through the group and taken on broader leadership roles across the platform.

About the Role

We are looking to recruit a Director to join FMA, based in New York City.

This position will play a central role in shaping and delivering FMA’s strategy in the Americas, combining senior-level client advisory, commercial leadership and talent development. The Director will be expected to act as a senior thought partner to FMA leadership, helping to identify priority themes, grow key client relationships, and build new advisory and investment collaboration opportunities aligned with BlackRock’s broader commercial objectives.

The role includes project execution, idea generation for new business opportunities, relationship management, business development, and advising clients on complex capital markets challenges in partnership with the group’s subject matter experts.

Externally, the role involves engagement with senior stakeholders across the region’s financial services and public sector ecosystems. Internally, the Director will leverage BlackRock’s capabilities across Capital Markets, Aladdin, Research and other businesses, acting as a connector across the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Areas of focus include:

• Exemplifying BlackRock’s fiduciary culture and delivering consistently high‑quality advisory outcomes for clients.
• Helping shape FMA’s strategic direction in the Americas, including identifying growth priorities, emerging themes, and opportunities for new offerings or partnerships.
• Directing and managing large, multi‑disciplinary project teams, incorporating subject matter experts, data and analytical specialists, researchers and generalists.
• Leading engagement design and planning, acting as the central point of coordination across multiple concurrent projects.
• Serving as a primary day‑to‑day liaison with clients, including senior executive stakeholders.
• Playing a hands‑on role in project execution through content creation, problem solving, quantitative analysis and provision of solutions‑oriented advice.
• Driving meaningful commercial impact, including originating new engagements, expanding existing relationships, and translating ideas into scaled advisory or investment collaborations.
• Interacting with BlackRock and client senior management, industry participants, lenders, developers and other investors.
• Acting as a senior leader, mentor and coach to the team, developing talent, strengthening project leadership capabilities, and fostering a collaborative and high‑performance culture.

Knowledge/Experience

• 10+ years of experience in the financial sector, with a preference for investment or corporate banking, strategy consulting, advisory or investment experience.
• Demonstrated record of commercial impact, including business building, revenue generation, or expansion of senior client relationships.
• Deep understanding of capital markets, with broad-based experience across a range of asset classes, including in private markets.
• Demonstrated understanding of the operating model and balance sheets of key financial ecosystem participants such as banks, insurance companies, pension funds and other asset owners.
• Comfort operating in ambiguous environments, with the judgement and drive to build new client solutions or offerings where no predefined playbook exists.
• Strategic mindset, with the ability to operate as a trusted advisor to senior executives and to shape longer‑term agendas.
• Strong entrepreneurial orientation, with a track record of identifying opportunities and translating them into tangible outcomes.
• Demonstrated ability to lead, develop and coach diverse teams in a high‑intensity environment.
• Excellent problem‑solving abilities, intellectual curiosity and sound judgement.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex issues clearly for senior audiences.
• Strong organisational skills, resilience under pressure, and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Strong quantitative and technical skills, with a passion for finance, markets and/or sustainability concepts.

For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$210,000.00 - USD$270,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

About Us
Coupang is at the forefront of the AI and high-performance computing (HPC) revolution. We are building a next-generation cloud platform designed to provide developers, researchers, and enterprises with seamless, scalable, and powerful access to accelerated computing. As the demand for AI, machine learning, and data-intensive workloads skyrockets, we are looking for a visionary product leader to define the future of our core compute offerings.
Job Overview
CIC is looking for a Group Product Manager to own the foundational compute platform that powers enterprise AI workloads. This role spans fleet management, capacity management, bare metal, virtualized compute, node lifecycle, placement, reservations, and infrastructure-level customer experience.
The Product Manager will be responsible for turning physical GPU and CPU capacity into reliable, customer-ready, observable, and billable compute products. This includes defining how capacity is reserved, provisioned, validated, monitored, maintained, packaged, and exposed to enterprise customers.
This role sits at the compute foundation layer. It enables higher-level orchestration and workload services such as Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, jobs, notebooks, and inference endpoints. The candidate should understand how those orchestration and workload systems depend on foundational compute infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
Define the product strategy and roadmap for CIC's compute platform across fleet, capacity, bare metal, and virtualized compute, working backwards from customer AI workload requirements.
Own the product lifecycle from infrastructure capacity to customer-ready compute, including reservation, provisioning, lifecycle actions, observability, billing integration, maintenance, and deprecation, with clear linkage to customer workload readiness.
Define customer-facing abstractions for capacity, node pools, bare metal instances, VM instances, placement policies, OS/runtime images, and reserved compute based on how customers run AI training, inference, and cluster operations.
Partner with engineering and infrastructure operations to define fleet readiness, lifecycle states, failure handling, maintenance workflows, and operational requirements.
Partner with sales, solutions, support, and finance to understand enterprise AI workload requirements and translate them into compute offerings, including reserved capacity, dedicated infrastructure, and VM/bare metal packaging.
Define product requirements for supported compute configurations, including GPU type, node shape, OS/runtime image, network/storage attachment, and compatibility expectations for customer AI workloads.
Improve the reliability, usability, and supportability of CIC compute products across customer onboarding, provisioning, and day-2 operations.
Drive roadmap decisions that improve utilization, reduce stranded capacity, increase enterprise readiness, and lower operational support burden.
Support enterprise customer discovery and roadmap prioritization for bare metal, VMs, reserved capacity, and dedicated infrastructure, with specific attention to customer workload patterns, performance needs, operational workflows, and production readiness.
Create clear product narratives, customer-facing materials, sales enablement, launch plans, and executive updates for enterprise compute offerings.
Track product and business metrics such as usable capacity, allocated capacity, stranded capacity, provisioning time, replacement time, utilization, revenue per deployed GPU, and support burden.
Basic Qualifications
8+ years of product management, technical product management, or equivalent product leadership experience in cloud infrastructure, compute, virtualization, GPU cloud, HPC, private cloud, or enterprise infrastructure platforms.
Experience working backwards from customer workload requirements to define infrastructure products, ideally for AI training, fine-tuning, inference, HPC, data-intensive workloads, or enterprise production systems.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with engineering, infrastructure operations, finance, sales, support, executive stakeholders, and enterprise customers.

Experience with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, CUDA, NCCL, OFED, driver compatibility, firmware lifecycle, GPU health/telemetry, or supported GPU software stack management.
Experience with distributed AI training or inference infrastructure, including Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray, model serving platforms, high-performance networking, shared storage, or checkpointing workflows.
Experience with reserved capacity, committed-use contracts, dedicated clusters, savings plans, or enterprise infrastructure commitments.
Experience with bare metal-as-a-service, GPU passthrough virtualization, VM image lifecycle, custom images, or cloud control plane products.

THE ROLE: We are seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to lead cable-related sourcing and supply management activities for server and rack system solutions. This position will partner with cable suppliers, engineering teams, procurement, and other cross-functional stakeholders to manage sourcing activities throughout the product design and development lifecycle. The Strategic Sourcing Manager will be responsible for supplier quotations and negotiations, costed BOM management, NPI development costs, material readiness, forecast and demand execution, and supply-chain risk mitigation. THE PERSON: The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented sourcing and supply-chain professional with experience supporting cable products used in server and rack systems. You have a strong understanding of BOM structures, product design milestones, NPI processes, supplier management, procurement principles, and material planning. You can manage multiple priorities, analyze complex information, maintain accurate trackers, and communicate effectively with suppliers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders. You take ownership of issues, act with urgency, and follow actions through resolution. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Conduct RFQs with cable suppliers for costed BOMs, NPI development expenses, tooling or other applicable nonrecurring costs, and engineering change requirements at each product design milestone. Evaluate supplier quotations and negotiate pricing, development costs, change-related expenses, material commitments, and delivery schedules. Develop and maintain effective working relationships with cable suppliers to support sourcing, product development, and supply continuity objectives. Track and manage cable-related BOMs, part numbers, supplier information, costs, and change histories throughout each milestone of the product design lifecycle. Partner with engineering teams and cable suppliers to understand design requirements, identify sourcing dependencies, and support the timely execution of NPI activities. Monitor raw-material readiness with suppliers and maintain clear, well-structured trackers for material status, shortages, risks, actions, owners, and recovery dates. Identify, track, and report critical material shortages and coordinate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to expedite raw materials and improve delivery schedules. Release cable-related forecasts and demand orders to suppliers and negotiate supply commitments to support required production and material delivery schedules. Work with suppliers, engineers, procurement, and supply-chain teams to develop and execute material-readiness and supply-risk mitigation plans. Proactively identify potential continuity, capacity, lead-time, quality, cost, and delivery risks and drive corrective actions through resolution. Manage material readiness in a manner that supports supply continuity while reducing excess and obsolete inventory exposure. Use analytical tools and supply-chain data to evaluate forecasts, demand requirements, supplier performance, material readiness, and sourcing risks. Communicate status, priorities, issues, and recommended actions clearly and accurately to suppliers and internal stakeholders. Demonstrate strong planning and organizational skills by maintaining accurate sourcing and material-readiness trackers. Manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced product development and supply-chain environment. Take accountability for assigned actions and proactively drive issues to timely resolution. Collaborate effectively across organizations to achieve sourcing, supply-chain, and company objectives. Maintain a strong focus on results, information accuracy, and attention to detail PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply planning, supplier management, or a related supply-chain function. Industry experience within ODM/OEM manufacturing, server system solutions, rack-level infrastructure, electronics, cables, or a related technology manufacturing environment. Experience managing supplier RFQs, costed BOMs, NPI development expenses, forecasts, purchase or demand releases, and delivery commitments. Knowledge of cable products, BOM structures, part number management, product design processes, and engineering change activities for server or rack systems. Experience monitoring supplier material readiness, identifying material shortages, expediting deliveries, and developing supply-risk mitigation plans. Understanding of excess and obsolete inventory risk and the relationship between forecasts, demand changes, supplier commitments, and material procurement. Advanced analytical, problem-solving, communication, negotiation, multitasking, and prioritization skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience analyzing data using PivotTables, VLOOKUP or comparable lookup functions, formulas, filters, and structured trackers. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with suppliers, engineers, procurement professionals, operations teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders. Proficiency in procurement and supply-chain principles and practices. Professional proficiency in English; bilingual proficiency in Mandarin is preferred. The Support team is central to ensuring that our customers' experience with our products is nothing short of exceptional. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engagement Specialist on the User Operations team you will be a hands-on systems builder responsible for making product launches and frontline feedback more scaleable, measurable and actionable across both internal User Operations and external third-party teams. You’ll be responsible for not only managing the project timelines, but also designing and shipping the workflows, tooling and data systems that connect the voice of the user into actionable improvements for Product and Engineering teams.

We’re looking for people who thrive at the intersection of project management, team enablement, and customer advocacy, and enjoy working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

We are also looking for individuals that will not just do the day to day work - but will also be deeply involved in architecting the systems of feedback sharing and collection with our stakeholder groups across Support, Product, and Engineering. Think data systems, not better slide decks.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Design, build, and own scalable systems for launch readiness, feedback capture, triage, synthesis, and routing.

- Coordinate product launches across internal User Operations teams and external third party teams to ensure seamless execution and support readiness.

- Develop and implement scalable feedback loops between support teams and product/engineering teams, ensuring customer insights are integrated into product development and strategy.

- Serve as the voice of the user, advocating for their needs and pain points in product and engineering discussions.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations) to align on product launch goals and timelines.

- Lead efforts to document and standardize launch procedures, ensuring they are easily repeatable and scalable as the product line grows.

- Monitor post-launch performance, gathering data from support teams to evaluate product impact and inform future improvements.

- Identify potential risks and challenges during product rollouts, proposing solutions to mitigate disruptions to customer service.

- Regularly report on the performance of the feedback loop, including key insights, trends, and actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have 8+ years of experience in product launch coordination, especially within a customer support environment (internal and/or external).

- Bring product management, technical program management, or similarly hands-on experience taking ambiguous problems from discovery through delivery and adoption.

- Enjoy working cross-functionally and are skilled at building relationships with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.

- Are technically fluent in areas such as APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics, automation, or lightweight scripting, even if you are not a software engineer.

- Are passionate about customer advocacy and have experience translating customer feedback into strategic product insights.

- Are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.

- Have excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and customer pain points to diverse audiences.

- Are proactive and take ownership of initiatives, from ideation through to implementation and post-launch analysis.

- Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly.

- Have a data-driven mindset, using metrics and feedback to guide decision-making and optimize processes.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Digital Trust PMO 조직 내 Business Controlling & Analytics 핵심 팀원으로서 조직 운영 전반에 대한 예산, 구매, 계약, 인력 및 운영 데이터를 관리하고 지원하는 역할입니다. 본 포지션은 단순한 데이터 분석가(Data Analyst)가 아닌, PMO 관점에서 조직 운영을 지원하고 관리할 수 있는 Business Operations 및 Operational Management 전문가를 채용하기 위한 포지션입니다.

주요 업무는 연간 예산 계획(AOP) 수립 지원, 분기별 Forecast 및 Actual 관리, 구매 및 계약 운영, Vendor 및 Invoice 관리, Headcount 및 채용 현황 관리, Executive Reporting 지원 등으로 구성되며, 조직 운영 전반이 원활하게 수행될 수 있도록 다양한 운영 프로세스를 관리하고 지원하는 핵심 역할을 담당합니다.
또한 PMO Manager 및 조직 리더들과 긴밀히 협업하며 예산, 인력, 구매, 계약 및 운영 현황에 대한 가시성을 제공하고, 조직의 의사결정을 지원하기 위한 운영 데이터 및 리포트를 제공하게 됩니다.

본 역할은 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 다수의 업무를 동시에 관리하고, 변화하는 비즈니스 우선순위에 유연하게 대응할 수 있는 높은 수준의 실행력, 꼼꼼함, Ownership 및 Stakeholder Management 역량을 요구합니다.
특히 다양한 글로벌 이해관계자와 직접 협업하는 역할인 만큼, 한국어와 영어를 활용하여 통역 없이 원활하게 커뮤니케이션할 수 있는 역량이 필수적입니다.

본 포지션은 Power BI 또는 Tableau 중심의 순수 Data Analytics 역할이 아니며, PMO 운영, 예산 관리, 구매 및 계약 운영, 인력 관리, Executive Reporting 등 조직 운영 전반을 지원하고 관리하는 Business Operations 중심의 역할입니다.본 포지션은 대규모 조직의 운영을 지원하는 역할로, 여러 업무를 동시에 처리하고 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 높은 수준의 정확성과 실행력을 유지할 수 있는 분을 찾고 있습니다.
